key_provisions_or_claims: Legal personhood for sexual autonomous robots, including rights against robotic sexual violence, is part of an appropriate legal response.
Politically liberal argument for legally proscribing robotic sexual violence.
Legal personification of lethal autonomous weapons, with a duty not to attack civilians, addresses lethal accidents.
LAWs are likened to quasi-employees of a military enterprise.
Reform strict product liability, since LAWs are both products and persons.
annotation.summary_en: Oxford DPhil thesis arguing for legal personhood for autonomous AI in two contexts: sexual autonomous robots, who should hold rights against robotic sexual violence, and lethal autonomous weapons, which should bear legal duties toward civilians. It also proposes reforming strict product liability to treat LAWs as both products and persons.
annotation.title_clean: Robots from Venus, robots from Mars: legal personhood for autonomous AI
annotation.title_en: Robots from Venus, robots from Mars: legal personhood for autonomous AI
